purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling component of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software system, specifically managing an insurance information update/entry screen (screen S09). It handles screen initialization, input validation (insured person number, society/national insurance classification, principal/family classification, symbol, number), combo-box population, and navigation between screens.

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in the displayed comments and string literals. The program is clearly production-grade COBOL from the JMA ORCA medical software suite (circa 2009 based on the date 09.09.07 in the header). The MCP event model (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WIDGET) is specific to the ORCA framework and resembles an online/interactive program rather than batch. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~50KB total.
